top_level_file_field_semantics: Each file record path, bytes, and sha256 describe the canonical build file; actual raw and normalized live response observations are separate.
route_normalization: For declared redirect target comparison only: remove terminal .html or index.html and a terminal slash; host and scheme must match.

known_hosting_body_transformations.name: cloudflare_challenge_platform_script_injection
known_hosting_body_transformations.rule: Remove exactly one script containing /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js only when its entire template matches the recorded SHA-256 after replacing the ray-id and base64 timestamp fields.

scope: Canonical bytes are recorded separately from raw HTTP response bytes and normalized response bytes. HTML meta-refresh stubs are checked as stubs plus their declared separately fetched destination; browser execution is not claimed.
